description: Production coupled multi-domain screening inference: Pantheon+ full-covariance SNe (coupled to host-disk screening rho_half) × live unclamped hi_class Boltzmann CMB acoustic/TTTEEE & omega_cdm=0 Planck 2018 lensing marginalized over 0.15-dex sheet/filament structure-scale priors × live-calibrated AlterBBN C nuclear network × exact two-branch PPN Cassini & galactic screening
interpretation: Production coupled joint inference across Pantheon+ SNe, unclamped live hi_class CMB Boltzmann acoustic transfer + omega_cdm=0 Planck 2018 lensing marginalized over the sheet/filament structure-scale priors (mode-centered 17x17 Gauss-Hermite, 9x9 vs 17x17 max diff 0.0092 lnL), AlterBBN C nuclear network abundances, and two-branch PPN/galactic screening converges with common-baseline log Z = -888.79 +/- 0.10 (peak-normalized log Z = -885.66; profiled-nuisance comparison log Z = -885.12 +/- 0.09, full 2D Occam penalty -3.66 = -3.13 peak + -0.54 shape). The posterior recovers epsilon_T = 0.8826 +/- 0.0502, z_T = 4.24 +/- 1.13, log10(g_t) = -9.4678 +/- 0.0350, and log10(rho_half/[M_sun/pc^3]) = -0.3031 +/- 0.1509 (rho_half = 0.498 M_sun/pc^3 = 3.368e-23 g/cm^3) with low cross-domain degeneracy (max |r| = 0.588), while live hi_class evaluation at the posterior mean confirms r_s^TEP / r_s^LCDM = 1.000000, CDM-free Planck 2018 9-bin lensing chi2 = 15.40, and Cassini PPN conjunction safety |gamma - 1|_(1.6 R_sun) = 4.325e-08 < 2.3e-5 (532x margin).

lensing_nuisance_marginalization.treatment: Mode-centered 2D Gauss-Hermite (17x17 verified against 9x9 to <= 0.0092 lnL) marginalization of the data-only Planck CMBMarged lensing chi2 over independent 0.15-dex Gaussian priors on the sheet and filament structure scales, evaluated against the common reference baseline lnL_lens_ref = -0.5 * chi2_lens_min shared with the profiled comparison run
lensing_nuisance_marginalization.interpretation: Both the marginalized and profiled runs subtract the identical parameter-independent reference constant lnL_lens_ref = -0.5 * chi2_lens_min, so log_evidence_marginalized - log_evidence_profiled is the unshifted full Occam prior-volume penalty of the 2D sheet/filament Gaussian prior.

likelihood_engines.BBN: Direct AlterBBN C nuclear network (primary.x standard) response surface over delta_H/H + empirical light-element abundance registry (Y_p, D/H, 3He/H, 7Li/H)
likelihood_engines.CMB: Unclamped [0.0, 0.500] 2D patched hi_class (classy) Boltzmann response surface (100*theta_s, rs_rec) + Planck 2018 TTTEEE + omega_cdm=0 CMBMarged 9-bin lensing likelihood marginalized over sheet/filament structure-scale priors
likelihood_engines.PPN_and_Galactic: Exact two-branch kinetic solver c1*q*y^2 + q^2*y^3 = 1 at 1 AU and Cassini solar limb (1.6 R_sun) + SPARC/Gaia wide-binary transition g_t
likelihood_engines.SNe: Pantheon+SH0ES 1701x1701 full covariance Cholesky profile likelihood coupled to host-disk screening S_host(rho_half)
